note: A replay of the pattern on the CPSC's 2026 docket on recall claims (one device filing over 400 claims, photos from the same vantage point), not of the real claims: one claimed sample photo, 400 copies made with the changes the reuse run measures, filed by turns at two fictional sample firms through the claim path's hash step with no model call, no network and no database. Recorded by scripts/public/docket-replay.ts; tests/docket-replay.test.ts checks it and runs the first claims again.
